snippet.title: Laundering Simulator – Full Trailer
snippet.description:
Business in the front, party in the back!

In Laundering Simulator, you run a unique, two-faced business – a clean, innocent laundromat front for a state-of-the-art counterfeiting workshop in the back! 

Join Eddie Wiser, a savvy inventor and our story's unlikely hero, as he runs this wild enterprise, all the while managing a small laundromat business, trading in his illicit bootlegs as well as struggling with the local authorities, criminal underworld, and his rage-inducing grandmother!

Check out our Steam page for more details!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432750/Laundering_Simulator
